classification: Post-event retrospective probability-training experiment; separate prospective challenger pending compatible inputs
hypothesis: CRPS-trained direct future-price probabilities improve seven-day quantile pinball versus matched categorical-CE, untuned interfaces and native numerical controls

data.selection: All metadata-qualified exact target series; uniform date subsampling only when cap binds; no performance filtering

distribution.level_rule: Zero plus ten geometrically spaced positive and negative log-return levels; extent=max(log(2),1.1*max(abs(training returns))); frozen using training only
distribution.categorical_target: Nearest positive dollar support level; earlier level wins exact tie
distribution.quantile_rule: Left inverse CDF: first support level whose cumulative probability is >= tau
distribution.failure: Persistence fallback, record failure and keep cell
distribution.support_gate: At least 95% of development labels within registered training-derived support and median development nearest-support absolute error <= persistence median absolute error; if persistence error is zero require zero quantization error

training.selection: Lowest development seven-day mean dollar pinball; checkpoint zero eligible; earliest update then lower learning rate breaks exact ties
training.crps_scale: One fixed median training anchor, independent of objective and evaluation outcomes
training.losses: Both use softmax over the identical registered answer-token logprobs; CE categorical NLL versus exact discrete CRPS against actual unrounded price
training.example_schedule: Identical seeded shuffled without-replacement horizon-task order; stop at one epoch or 200 updates
training.checkpoint_retention: Selected immutable optimizer state per run, short-lived sampler exports; existing checkpoints untouched

evaluation.classification: Opened historical dates; no independent or prospective accuracy claim
evaluation.original_json_control: Retained untuned v14 price-only predictions on exact matched cells only; report its separate subset denominator
evaluation.chronos: Use only existing exact matched predictions, otherwise explicitly unavailable
evaluation.zero_baseline_loss: Relative skill null; absolute difference retained
